# Spinner

Activity indicator for one action or a small area where the layout is not known yet.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Spinner` · Status

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Spinner />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Spinner"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Spinning ring (role=status). Falls back to static dots + visible label under prefers-reduced-motion.

## Props (SpinnerProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `number` | Diameter in px. @default 20 |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` | Announced text; shown visually with showLabel or when reduced motion is on. @default "Loading" |
| `showLabel` | `boolean` | @default false |
| `tone` | `'brand' \| 'current' \| 'onInk'` | brand: action blue. current: inherits text colour. onInk: white. @default "brand" |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>._
